import type { CallContext, CallResult } from '@tsir/link';
import { createRestClient, type RestClient, type RestClientOptions } from '@tsir/link/rest';

/** The shape `GET {{prefix}}/:id` answers with. Replace it with the real one. */
export interface {{base}}Record {
  readonly id: string;
}

/**
 * Generated by `tsir make:link-client`. Options are constructor-injected: the base URL, the host
 * allowlist and the credentials come in here, and nothing reads the environment.
 */
export class {{className}} {
  readonly #rest: RestClient;

  constructor(options: RestClientOptions) {
    this.#rest = createRestClient(options);
  }

  /** The caller's `ctx` carries the trace, the deadline and the cancellation. */
  get(ctx: CallContext, id: string): Promise<CallResult<{{base}}Record>> {
    return this.#rest.call<{{base}}Record>({
      method: 'GET',
      path: `{{prefix}}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`,
      ctx,
      responseType: 'json',
    });
  }
}
